pomProject.name: Byte Buddy (without dependencies)
pomProject.description: Byte Buddy is a Java library for creating Java classes at run time. This artifact is a build of Byte Buddy with all ASM dependencies repackaged into its own name space.

pomProject.name: Byte Buddy (with dependencies)
pomProject.description: Byte Buddy is a Java library for creating Java classes at run time. This artifact is a build of Byte Buddy with a remaining dependency onto ASM. You should never depend on this module without repackaging Byte Buddy and ASM into your own namespace.

pomProject.name: Apache Commons Codec
pomProject.description: The Apache Commons Codec package contains simple encoder and decoders for various formats such as Base64 and Hexadecimal.  In addition to these widely used encoders and decoders, the codec package also maintains a collection of phonetic encoding utilities.

pomProject.name: Apache Commons Exec
pomProject.description: Apache Commons Exec is a library to reliably execute external processes from within the JVM.

pomProject.name: Apache Commons Exec
pomProject.description: Apache Commons Exec is a library to reliably execute external processes from within the JVM.

pomProject.name: Apache Commons IO
pomProject.description: The Apache Commons IO library contains utility classes, stream implementations, file filters, file comparators, endian transformation classes, and much more.

pomProject.name: Apache Commons Lang
pomProject.description: Apache Commons Lang, a package of Java utility classes for the classes that are in java.lang's hierarchy, or are considered to be so standard as to justify existence in java.lang.

pomProject.name: Apache Commons Logging
pomProject.description: Apache Commons Logging is a thin adapter allowing configurable bridging to other, well known logging systems.

pomProject.name: CSS Parser
pomProject.description: A CSS parser which implements SAC (the Simple API for CSS).

pomProject.name: Guava: Google Core Libraries for Java
pomProject.description: Guava is a suite of core and expanded libraries that include utility classes, google's collections, io classes, and much much more. Guava has only one code dependency - javax.annotation, per the JSR-305 spec.

pomProject.name: Guava: Google Core Libraries for Java
